title: Daily briefing: We’re close to reaching a 30% land-conservation target
title_zh: 每日简报：我们接近达成30%陆地保护目标
abstract: More land for conservation is positive, but doesn’t necessarily protect biodiversity, say researchers. Plus, say goodbye to the leap second and how the Inca empire lasted longer than we thought.
abstract_zh: 更多的保护用地是好事，但研究人员指出，这不一定能保护生物多样性。此外，再见闰秒，以及印加帝国存续的时间比我们想象的要长。
snippet: More land for conservation is positive, but doesn’t necessarily protect biodiversity, say researchers. Plus, say goodbye to the leap second and how the Inca empire lasted longer than we thought.
